parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or ventilating air through the system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support for the motor and fan blades.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the motor and fan blades in place, allowing stable operation and mounting to other surfaces or devices.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the rotating fan assembly.
